# Float Values

#### Course: Learn CSS

## Float Values

The float property has two main values: left and right. These values determine where the element is "floated" within its container, allowing other content to flow around it.

Consider the example below:

```html
1<div class="box"></div>
2<p class="content">This is some sample text.</p>
```

```css
1.box {
2    height: 200px;
3    width: 200px;
4    border-radius: 20px;
5    background: #ddd;
6}
```

Output

![Float Example](data:image/png;base64,)

In this example, we have a <div> with the class box and a paragraph of text.

If we set float: left on the box, the element will move to the left, and the text will flow to its right, occupying the remaining space.

You'll see how this works next.
